response.sql: WITH album_rates AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price, AVG(Bytes * 1.0 / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId) SELECT AlbumId, average_unit_price, bytes_per_millisecond, bytes_per_millisecond - (SELECT AVG(bytes_per_millisecond) FROM album_rates) AS rate_above_average FROM album_rates ORDER BY rate_above_average DESC LIMIT 10;
